note: Clayton (Thousand Islands), inland off Rte 12E 1.2 miles west of town. Pool, game room, efficiencies and a cottage; overnight or full-season stays. Directory listings (not the operator) give 61-66 sites, 48 full-hookup, 5 pull-thru, 40 ft max, 30/50A. --Claude
summary: Operator site live (phone matches; Google Maps 4.4 / 85 reviews). Changed base rate $35 -> $40: $35 is the pull-behind camper price, a motor home pays $40 (W/E) / $45 (full). Rates are undated on the page. Confirmed reservable (phone/email), water and sewer hookups, seasonal (first full weekend in May to third weekend in October), showers and Wi-Fi. Cleared aggregator-only 50 A, 66 sites, 40 ft and pull-through. Long-stay tests pass: own nightly rate + phone, no application or minimum, no site count, not a home community (it offers 'overnight or full season accommodations'). $40-45 is under the gate. Family has not stayed here.
